Kuvitus: pöydällä on avoin kirja. Vasemm: Illustration: an open book lies on a desk. On the left page is an old picture of an atom in which a small electron goes round the nucleus along a circular orbit. On the right page the same atom is drawn as a blue cloud of dots, and next to it is a two-lobed p orbital. A desk lamp lights the book.
Kaavakuva: molemmista päistä kiinnitetyn: Schematic figure: the first three standing waves of a string fixed at both ends. In the top one the string vibrates as one antinode and there is no node in its middle, in the middle one there is one node and two antinodes, and in the bottom one two nodes and three antinodes. No other ways of vibrating arise, because the ends of the string stay in place. The more nodes, the greater the frequency of the vibration.
Periaatekuva, ei mittakaavassa: vetyatom: Schematic figure, not to scale: cross-sections through the nucleus of three orbitals of the hydrogen atom. The 1s orbital is a sphere with no node. The 2s orbital is a sphere with a nodal sphere inside it: the electron is not detected there, and inside and outside it the wave oscillates in opposite phases. The 2p orbital has two lobes, one on each side of the nucleus, and between them a nodal plane through the nucleus. The figure shows one of the three 2p orbitals, with vertical lobes; the other two point in two other directions. The nucleus is a red dot.
Pistekuva mittakaavassa: vetyatomin 1s-e: Dot figure to scale: the position of the 1s electron of a hydrogen atom has been measured once, 20 times and 1000 times, and each measurement result is marked as a dot. One dot tells nothing about the distribution, 20 dots gather around the nucleus, and 1000 dots form a cloud that is densest near the nucleus and thins out outwards. In the third picture a circle has been drawn that contains 90 percent of the hits: it is the boundary of the 1s orbital, radius 0.14 nm. The hits left outside the boundary are grey. The figure is a see-through projection: the three-dimensional hits have been drawn in one plane, so some of the grey dots appear inside the circle although they are in front of or behind the boundary. The nucleus is a red dot.
Vetyatomin energiatasot mittakaavassa ja: The energy levels of the hydrogen atom to scale and their orbitals as boxes. The shell n = 1 has one orbital, 1s, with the energy −13.6 eV. The shell n = 2, with the energy −3.40 eV, has the 2s orbital and three 2p orbitals, four altogether. The shell n = 3, with the energy −1.51 eV, has 3s, three 3p and five 3d orbitals, nine altogether. At the top is a dashed line E = 0, above which the electron is free of the atom. The arrow shows the transition of the electron from the 3d orbital to the 2p orbital; at the same time a photon is produced with a wavelength of 656 nm, red light. Each orbital can hold at most two electrons.
